chapter: Teaching, the 1951 Big Show and New York nights
title: Plans to record as a leader; Kenny Burrell and Dizzy offers
summary: Collins has never recorded as a leader but intends to, with Jimmy Jones arranging; Burrell and Dizzy Gillespie want to record with him.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: This is -- I'm getting it together now.
Jimmie Jones and I. He's going to do some arranging for me. And I'm going to just some solo work.
I believe you said earlier that you'd never recorded as a solo artist or a leader.. (Inaudible)
Yeah, I don't know why I just --

Yeah, I don't know why, I just never did, and I've been approached and I've said, okay, I'll do it. And then I'm off to the races or something, and I just don't do it, you know. But I am definitely going to do it because I have a lot of things that I want to say, you know. And
(Inaudible). Kenny Burrell wants you -- wants to record you. I don't know whether he wants to record with you or --
I don't know. Kenny has been wanting to produce a record for me, so I don't know.
Kenny does, he has (inaudible) that kind of a deal at Fantasy Records.
I know, I know he has and --
And Dizzy says he wants to do one with you.
